---
title: Send a Multi-Hop Invoice Payment
description: Create an invoice and pay through a public Fiber intermediary without a direct channel to the receiver
date: 2026-08-10
full: true
---

This interactive tutorial runs a sender and receiver as separate Fiber WASM
nodes on one page. Follow the live demo step by step to prepare both nodes,
create an invoice for certain CKB, and submit a real Testnet multi-hop payment through Bottle.
